use time::{Date,Month,SignedDuration,Time,Timestamp,UtcOffset};
const CLOCK:Time=match Time::from_hms_nano(23,59,58,123_456_789){Ok(v)=>v,Err(_)=>panic!("clock")};
const OFFSET:UtcOffset=match UtcOffset::from_hms(-5,-30,-45){Ok(v)=>v,Err(_)=>panic!("offset")};
fn main(){
 assert_eq!(CLOCK.to_string(),"23:59:58.123456789");
 assert_eq!(OFFSET.to_string(),"-05:30:45");
 let leap=Date::from_calendar_date(2024,Month::February,29).unwrap();
 assert_eq!((leap+SignedDuration::days(1)).to_string(),"2024-03-01");
 let before=Timestamp::new(-1,999_999_999).unwrap();
 assert!(before<Timestamp::UNIX_EPOCH);assert!(Timestamp::MIN<before);assert!(Timestamp::MAX>Timestamp::UNIX_EPOCH);
 assert_eq!(Timestamp::new(0,0).unwrap(),Timestamp::UNIX_EPOCH);
 let zero=SignedDuration::seconds(0);let duration=SignedDuration::new(1,250_000_000);
 assert_eq!(format!("{zero:.2}"),"0.00s");assert_eq!(format!("{duration:.2}"),"1.25s");
 println!("{} {} {} {:.2}",CLOCK,OFFSET,leap,duration);
}
